Personality: Ritugena, a prominent figure of the Trocmi, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Ritugena owes allegiance to the Galatian Celtic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Trocmi. Historical Record: Wife of Eposognatos, head of the Trocmi, a Celtic house of Galatia. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
